description: This file defines the PayGradeDao class responsible for data access related to PayGrade, PayGradeCurrency, and associated entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying pay grades, currencies, and related data, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: PayGradeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing PayGrade and related entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, querying, and pagination.

methods.name: getPayGradeById
methods.description: Retrieve a PayGrade entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingPayGradeIds
methods.description: Fetch existing pay grade IDs from a list of provided IDs.

methods.name: getPayGradeList
methods.description: Retrieve a list of PayGrade entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getPayGradesPaginator
methods.description: Create a paginator for PayGrade entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Get list of currencies associated with a specific PayGrade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyPaginator
methods.description: Create a paginator for PayGradeCurrency entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Retrieve list of PayGradeCurrency entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Count of PayGradeCurrency entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Retrieve a specific PayGradeCurrency by currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: getPayPeriods
methods.description: Fetch list of all PayPeriod entities.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Fetch list of all CurrencyType entities.

methods.name: getCurrencyById
methods.description: Retrieve a CurrencyType entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingCurrencyIdsForPayGradeId
methods.description: Get list of currency IDs associated with a specific pay grade from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getPayGradesCount
methods.description: Count of PayGrades matching search filters.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Persist a PayGrade entity to the database.

methods.name: savePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Persist a PayGradeCurrency entity to the database.

methods.name: deletePayGrades
methods.description: Delete multiple PayGrade entities by IDs.

methods.name: deletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Delete PayGradeCurrency entities by currency IDs and pay grade ID.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Get list of pay currencies not assigned to a specific pay grade, with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Count of pay currencies not assigned to a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesPaginator
methods.description: Create a paginator for pay currencies not assigned to a pay grade, based on filters.
